status: authored 2026-09-26; generated into the cobblers_blackout pack by tools/blackout_pack.py; runtime proofs in experiments/EXP-042-blackout-and-water-ladder

money.percent_why: the owner, 2026-09-27: 'the death should be more punishing ... i should want to go back and kill that thing'. Was 10 (the spec's figure)
money.held_by_wild_victor_why: the money a wild Pokemon's win takes goes into its claim and comes back when it is beaten, caught or killed, so there is a reason to go back for it; an environmental death, a trainer loss and any other loss lose it outright
money.rounding: up; a balance above zero always loses at least 1 (ceil(balance * percent / 100))
money.currency_symbol_why: CobbleDollars shows balances with $ ('has $ 712'); the spec's copy uses a yen-style sign

dedupe_why: one incident: a battle loss and a death from the same defeat are charged once. Measured from the first of the two, which is processed at the moment it happens (a death is charged while the player is still on the death screen)

pallet.name: Hometown
pallet.position_basis: the world spawn in level.dat (docs/STATE.md 'Live world'), the campaign spawn the spec names as the fallback

checkpoints.center_radius_why: a Center's healing machine is inside its template, within 48 blocks (horizontal) of the placement anchor; the checkpoint is where the player stood when they used it
checkpoints.waystone_jump_why: travel through a waystone is detected as a jump of at least this many blocks (sampled every 5 ticks) that lands within the arrival radius of a town waystone; walking up to one is not travel
checkpoints.ids_rule: an id is never reused or renumbered: a player's saved checkpoint is this number. A Center or waystone the data no longer has falls back to Hometown

claims.exempt_why: docs/world-building/SOUTHERN_RIFT_MEGA.md decision 9 (the owner, 2026-09-27): a wild victor carrying this tag (the gulch's roaming Megas, tools/gulch_mine.py) makes no item claim and does not become a guardian: the mine's danger is the Megas, not a lost item, and a Mega already has its own leash. The loss still costs money and the return to the checkpoint
claims.slain_rule: a guardian found gone from its loaded site counts as killed by the last player (or player's Pokemon) who hurt it if that blow was noted after maintenance last saw the guardian alive (claim alive_t); vanilla forgets an attacker 100 ticks after the last blow, so an old fight never counts. Replaced a 400-tick window counted from when maintenance noticed, which rebuilt the guardian if the killer left (the test author's finding). The owner, 2026-09-27: killing it with a sword should work like beating it
claims.categories_why: raised 2026-09-27 for the owner's 'more punishing' (was balls 15% max 10, medicine 15% max 6, a 35% chance of one battle or evolution item, the spec's figures)
claims.balls_basis: #cobblemon:poke_balls in the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar, resolved, without the Master Ball, the Ancient Origin Ball, the Cherish Ball and the Park Ball (unique or story balls, spec: never lost)
claims.medicine_basis: #cobblemon:potions, full_heal_bottles, ethers, revives and remedies in the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar, plus full_heal and medicinal_leek
claims.consumables_basis: #cobblemon:evolution_stones, evolution_items and battle_items in the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar, without the two Kubfu scrolls (one per game)
claims.not_scanned: items inside backpacks, bundles or shulker boxes are not selected yet: the spec's nested-inventory proof is open (DEATH_AND_WIPE.md question 14)
claims.guardian_leash_why: a guardian further than this from its defeat site is walked back, so a missing guardian can be told from one that wandered into an unloaded chunk
claims.rebuild_after_passes_why: a guardian is rebuilt only after its site has been loaded, and it absent, on two passes in a row: entities load a moment after their chunk, and a single pass could rebuild one that was about to appear

water.deep_blocks_basis: DEATH_AND_WIPE.md 'What is gated': the player's eyes at least five contiguous water blocks below the local surface; a tuning value to check at Viltri, a river, the Dratini site and a trench
water.breath_reset_why: the Surf bonus resets only after the player's eyes stay in air, with full vanilla air, this long
water.pulse_fraction: half of maximum health, as drown damage (bypasses armour); vanilla's own 2-point drowning hit lands in the same second and is absorbed by the damage cooldown
water.pulse_regen_margin_why: a hit landing on a player at or below half health plus this is lethal, so two hits from full health knock out whatever natural regeneration adds between them (EXP-042 run 1: 20 to 10, regenerated to 11, the second hit left 2)
water.dive_swim_speed_why: a +50% movement_speed modifier (add_multiplied_base) while the Dive swim state holds: vanilla water movement accelerates toward movement speed in proportion to water_movement_efficiency, so the two together make the boost; efficiency alone felt like nothing (the owner, EXP-042 session 3). Estimated about 1.5-1.7x a normal sprint-swim, below Dolphin's Grace (about 2.5x); to be measured
water.dive_swim_efficiency_why: the owner, 2026-09-26: someone with Dive should swim faster, 'it shouldnt be the max level though'. generic.water_movement_efficiency is what Depth Strider uses, 0 to 1 with 1.0 = Depth Strider III; 0.5 sits between Depth Strider I and II. Applied in any water while the Dive training and a Dive-capable party member hold
water.ladder_oxygen_bonus_why: vanilla keeps a tick's air with chance bonus/(bonus+1): at 1000 a player loses about one air in 50 seconds, so the Surf bonus and Dive hold air full without the Water Breathing effect

vanilla_air.decision: removed (the owner, 2026-09-26): 'Respiration and Water Breathing route around the whole ladder, and the ladder is now progression. A mount-gated system with a potion bypass is not gated.'
vanilla_air.respiration: the enchantment is overridden with no effect and no supported items: no enchanting table offers it, no anvil applies it, an existing helmet or book does nothing
vanilla_air.water_breathing_and_conduit_power: cleared from survival players the tick they land (potions, turtle shells, conduits), with a one-time message
vanilla_air.sources_checked: vanilla (enchanting, librarian trades, loot books, fishing, brewing, turtle shells, conduits) plus seven mod loot tables that can roll a Water Breathing potion; no mod grants either effect in code (a class search of every jar for the effect fields found none; the control, Speed, found three)

surface.status: rule changed by the owner 2026-09-27 after EXP-044's first run; the new rule is built on staging, not yet run in game
surface.rule: every swim builds fatigue, in any water (sea, lakes, rivers): feet or eyes in water, riding nothing, and not wading (on the bottom with the head out). Water at least deep_water_blocks deep under the swimmer, or the eyes at the water ladder's depth, builds it gain_deep_per_tick; shallower water gain_shallow_per_tick. Land, wading and riding recover it
surface.why: the owner, 2026-09-26: a first-time Route 1 player 'cant swim without a surf mon'. The first rule (fatigue only 96+ blocks from land, tools/open_water.py) let the owner swim from Pallet to the landmass south-west of it without tiring (EXP-044 run 1). The owner, 2026-09-27: 'i want fatigue on every swim, maybe it would increase once you pass three blocks deep, but a new player should struggle with water'
surface.superseded: shallow_blocks 96 and deep_blocks 256 (distance-from-land bands); tools/open_water.py is no longer read by the pack
surface.deep_water_blocks_basis: the owner's 'three blocks deep': the feet's block and the two under it all water
surface.trained_partner: a player the water ladder qualifies (Surf or Dive training with a capable party Pokemon) builds fatigue at half the rate
surface.feel: at the measured sprint-swim of 5 blocks per second, in deep water an unaided swimmer is warned at 5 s (about 25 blocks), slowed at 7.5 s, exhausted at 11 s and hit from 15 s, about 70 blocks out once Slowness is counted, dead about 3 s later; in shallow water each step takes four times as long. A trained swimmer with a partner gets twice as far; riding a water Pokemon ends it. Rivers (at most about 32 wide) stay crossable; the channel south-west of Pallet (over 100 blocks of deep water) and every island strait do not, unaided
surface.boats: riding a boat is exempt from fatigue, so boats are shallows craft: see the "boats" section

boats.status: decided by the owner 2026-09-27 (WATER_PROPOSAL decision 1, option C): 'Boats: option C, shallows only. A boat should not defeat swimming, exhaustion and the ferry from day one.' Built on staging, not run in game
boats.rule: a player riding a boat or chest boat on sea water at least rough_blocks from land (tools/open_water.py's bands on the canonical heightmap, 16-block cells) is put out of it with the message, unless inside a sheltered box; then the swim rule applies. Coasts, lakes, rivers and the shallows stay boat water
boats.rough_blocks_why: the owner, 2026-09-27: 'Take 48. It is the only number that gates Sunset with real margin, and 13 blocks on the Relic row is nothing'. At 96 the Sunset strait's rough water on the ferry line was one 34-block stretch, swum in about 7 s between boats (the test author's contract C11); measured on the ferry lines: 64 gives 103 (a margin of about 13 over the unaided knock-out, 'the kind of margin that disappears'), 48 gives 142, Northlight 285, the Relic row 13

sheltered.why: the owner, 2026-09-27: 'Widen Pacifidlog's sheltered bay box to the whole bay so its boats keep working'. At rough_blocks 48 the bay's rough tongue runs from z6656 south to the open sea (band map, cells x6928-7359); the box stops where the bay meets the open sea at about z6944
the water in front of the raft town's southern decks, between the bay box and the town, so boats at the town keep working; the open sea west of x7040 and south of z6992 stays rough
